description: JavaScript functions for the execSetResults page in the TestLink project, handling form submissions, validation, and UI interactions related to test execution results.

methods.name: doSubmitForHTML5
methods.description: Shows overlay and triggers click on hidden submit button to submit the form.

methods.name: saveExecStatus
methods.description: Sets test case execution status and navigates accordingly.

methods.name: moveToNextTC
methods.description: Sets the current test case ID for moving to the next test case.

methods.name: checkStepsHaveContent
methods.description: Checks if test step notes or statuses have content before saving.

methods.name: checkStepsHaveAttachments
methods.description: Checks if any attachments are present in test steps.

methods.name: checkCustomFields
methods.description: Validates custom fields in the form before submission.

methods.name: checkSubmitForStatusCombo
methods.description: Prevents form submission if the status is set to a specific code.
